## Notes

- **MCP hosts (Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop)** — The stdio handshake against the published package proves initialize and tools/list, but no named host was driven. The Claude Desktop, Cursor and Claude Code snippets are documented in README.md only.
- **AI SDK** — The tests call the generated tool execute() functions directly; no model loop is driven.
- **elizaOS** — The action handler is driven with a fabricated agent message; no live elizaOS runtime is started.
- **n8n** — The node is driven through a fake n8n execution context and a stubbed HTTP helper; the hosted endpoint it calls is not contacted in the test.
- **@x402/core** — A real @x402/core client is driven with a throwaway key; the allowed case produces a signed payload, and the denied case aborts before anything is signed.
- **@x402/evm** — ExactEvmScheme from @x402/evm signs only after the hook returns pay. The throwaway key is never funded, so this is not an on-chain payment.
- **x402-fetch (v1, unscoped)** — The optional peer resolves and the no-peer message is not raised when it is installed. The signed-payment path is delegated to x402-fetch and is stubbed in the test, so this is not a funded end-to-end payment.
- **PayMCP** — Prose pairing only: the page maps PayMCP's documented 402 challenge to the evaluator input. No PayMCP server was run and no payment was made; their API may move.
- **Glama** — Live probe on 2026-11-20: all 10 tool names present. The overall check-listings run exited 1 because other surfaces were stale; this row was current.
- **mcp.so** — Live probe on 2026-11-20 found 3 of 10 tool names. The page is stale; updating it is the directory's crawl, not a repo change. check-listings exited 1 on this row.
- **npm — @paystage/mcp** — Live probe on 2026-11-20: published version 0.8.16 matches the local package. The overall check-listings run exited 1 because other surfaces were stale; this row was current.
- **Official MCP registry** — Live probe on 2026-11-20 returned 0.8.15 against local 0.8.16. The entry exists but is behind, so it is not current; republishing it was not part of this change. check-listings exited 1 on this row.
